description: Submits contact details and summary company information to Sell My Company Data for human review. Requires the user's explicit request, confirmed contact details and consent to be contacted. Creates an enquiry and triggers internal notifications and a confirmation email. Does not access or modify the user's connected apps. Repeated successful submissions create separate enquiries.

consent.description: true only if the user agreed to be contacted about an offer.

country.description: Where the company is based: us, ca (Canada), uk, eu, anz (Australia or New Zealand), other.

is_authorized.description: true if they are an owner or director, or are authorised to discuss data licensing for the company.

notes.description: Anything the user wants us to know. No personal data about other people.

role.description: Their position, for example Founder, CEO, Head of Operations.

slack_public_share.description: Share of Slack channels that are public. The value no_slack means the company does not use Slack.

systems.description: One entry per system that holds company data. May be empty if unknown.

category.description: What kind of system it is.

exportable.description: Whether the owner can export the data.

measured.description: true if the figure is a measured count, false if it is an estimate provided by the user.

people.description: Number of people who use it or appear in it.

since_year.description: Year of the oldest data in this system.

tool.description: Product name, for example Slack, HubSpot, Zendesk, Notion, GitHub.

volume.description: Short count such as "40k messages", "12k tickets", "8k contacts". Numbers only, no content.

name: request_offer
title: Request an offer from Sell My Company Data
